notes.title: Virtual Virtual Reality 2 Launches “Music Update”
notes.content:
Virtual Virtual Reality 2 added five new musical sequences! Here are the details for the “Music Update”:

[list]
[*] Mini rhythm games for each roommate upload
[*] Marty performs the theme song “Scottsdale” in a fully animated musical sequence 
[*] Scotts Pop bug fixes 
[*] General bug fixes and stabilization
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 11/10/2022
notes.content: - Fixed Grip binding (Butter Crawling) bug on VIVE

notes.title: Virtual Virtual Reality 2 releases on Tuesday, October 25th!
notes.content: Is it getting a bit... Steam-y in here??!! VVR2 is officially coming to Steam on Tuesday, October 25th. Wishlist it on Steam today and prepare to escape the metaverse!!

notes.title: Virtual Virtual Reality 2 Releases Summer 2022
notes.content:
Hey Future Scottsdale Citizens! 

We are hard at work on our Steam versions of VVR2. We want to be sure that when it launches, it’s the best version of the game for all supported platforms and control schemes. We are targeting this summer for launch on Steam and will keep you posted here. 

Thanks for both your support and your patience!

🐝
